title: Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
body:
Zehra Ka Ladla Bay Jurm Bay Khatha Haey Maara Gaya (2)
Yeh Zainab Ka, Hay Birader, Kay Outhree Hai, Jiskee Chadar, Houey Akbar, Zibah Asghar, O Kohram Hay Bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Diya Hau Tunay Asghar Diya Hay Tunay
Kehnai Laga Khuda Mazloom Shukriya Tera Ghar Bhi Lut Gaya (2)
Yeh Zainab Ka, Hay Birader, Kay Outhree Hai, Jiskee Chadar, Houey Akbar, Zibah Asghar, O Kohram Hay Bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Laash Bay Kafan Hay Sehra Mai Bay Dafan Hay
Hai Binna-e-Laillah Kehnai Laga Khuda Mazloom Shukriya (2)
Tu Rehbar Hay, Tu Sabir Hay, Kay Sajday Mey, Tera Sar Hai, Tu Ahmad Ka, Vo Dilbar Hay, Jo Hay Deen Ki Baqa
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaen-e-Rasool Tu Hay Jigar-e-Batool Tu Hay
Farzand-e-Mustafa Ehsan Hay Tera Tera Deen Bachgaya (2)
Tu Lut Ker Bhi. Houa Razi, Ha Mara Gaya, Tera Ghazi, Tu Bay Misl Hay, O Namaazi, O Mazloom-e-Kerbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera Gham Rahay Tabinda Tu Hay Hussain Zinda
Islam Bachgaya Kalmay Ki Hay Sada Tera Ghar Bhi Lut Gaya (2)
Tu Azmat Ka Hay Khazeena, Watan Tera, Hay Madina, Kay Tharsee Houee, Hay Sakina, Is Ko Galay Laga
